problems.problem: The contact detail crop [155,1012,493,1262] confirms a real soft contact shade hugging the green base edge (offset_y 0 is correct; do not move it), so the shadow itself is not the fault. The fault is the plane: the only cloth edge in the poster sits at ~y=875 while the bottle base is at y=1152, and the linen below that edge shows hanging vertical folds, i.e. a table skirt, not a receding tabletop. A shade on a vertical drape cannot carry weight, so the bottle still reads as hovering in front of the skirt, unlike reference 4 where can base, contact shadow and cloth top surface share one readable plane.
problems.root_cause: Background prompt still generates a front-facing drape below a high edge instead of a seated-eye-level tabletop band whose surface contains the base line.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate the background with a shallow receding linen surface band whose soft far edge crosses above y~1100 so the base at y=1152 stands on visible surface; keep oatmeal linen, diffuse frontal light, and shadow offset_y at 0.

problems.problem: Product bbox [235,432,413,1152] gives width ratio 0.165 and height ratio 0.50, the floor of the fresh-concept range, while the type column now starts at x=700; the ~287px grey gutter between silhouette and title plus the vacant right two-thirds leave no visual event in the 'offered span', so the waiting-place idea reads as unresolved emptiness rather than intentional vacancy. References 3-5 all activate their negative space (cast-shadow field, prop echo, splash); this draft does not.
problems.root_cause: Previous resize toward 0.60 height ratio was lost when the earlier patch batch was rejected; only the text shift survived, widening the gutter instead of closing it.
problems.repair_strategy: Re-apply the hero resize to ~0.60 height ratio at center_x 324 with base held at 1152 (center_y = 1152 - height/2), keeping the type column in the right margin so bottle, horizon and type form one left-to-right read.

problems.problem: Title bbox [700,605,1013,657] and subtitle bbox [705,720,869,736] leave a 63px optical void between the 74px Baskerville title and the 24px subtitle, so the two lines never lock into one block; both float in flat grey with no alignment tie to the horizon or the bottle shoulder. The repaired x-shift improved the margin axis but did not address the vertical gap.
problems.root_cause: Subtitle y was never coupled to the title baseline; the surviving repair only moved x coordinates.
problems.repair_strategy: Set subtitle.y to ~690 to close the block, keep exact copy, serif family and left alignment at the shared x axis.

problems.problem: The upper two-thirds remains a flat warm-grey wall with a faint gradient and no material or light event, and the lower cloth reads as skirt; together the setting still looks like a pasted cutout on a backdrop rather than the seated tabletop scene the concept declares. No studio equipment artifacts are present (good), but the environment is under-authored versus reference 4's saturated cloth plane and deep field.
problems.root_cause: The previous background.prompt rewrite was inside the rejected patch batch, so the renderer kept the old drape-generating prompt.
problems.repair_strategy: Re-issue the background prompt describing an empty oatmeal linen tabletop surface band with soft frontal daylight falloff and a calm warm grey rear wall, no equipment, no product words.
